common:generalComment.#text: Rubber powder is a material obtained from the processing of scrap tires. It is sieved according to size and filled into bulk bags or containers. It has stress absorbing properties and is used in asphalt application for performance and durability. It is incorporated into several polymers and products. Processing waste tires into tire rubber powder is an important way to recycle waste tires. Different production methods produce tire rubber powder with different fineness and different applications.
橡胶粉是从废旧轮胎加工中获得的材料。它根据大小进行筛选，并装入大型袋子或容器中。它具有吸收压力的特性，用于沥青应用以提高性能和耐久性。它被纳入到多种聚合物和产品中。将废旧轮胎加工成轮胎橡胶粉是回收废旧轮胎的重要方式。不同的生产方法会产生具有不同细度和不同应用的轮胎橡胶粉。

common:generalComment.#text: Glass Fiber Reinforced Plastics (GFRP) are composite materials made from a combination of fine glass fibers and a thermosetting resin. They are used in various industries due to their superior mechanical performances, making them good substitutes for engineering plastics or metals. These materials have gained popularity due to their strength, durability, and eco-friendly characteristics. They can even replace steel in some applications.
玻璃纤维增强塑料（GFRP）是由细玻璃纤维和热固性树脂组合而成的复合材料。由于其优越的机械性能，它们在各种行业中得到了应用，使它们成为工程塑料或金属的良好替代品。这些材料因其强度、耐用性和环保特性而受到欢迎。它们甚至可以在某些应用中替代钢材。
